mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sy_automation_run (job_cd,run_dt,state_cd,last_step,start_dttm,end_dttm,error_cn,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES (#{key.jobCode},#{key.runDate},'RUNNING',0,#{at},NULL,NULL,'SYSTEM',#{at}) ON CONFLICT (job_cd,run_dt) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_automation_run SET state_cd=#{state},last_step=#{lastStep},end_dttm=#{endedAt},error_cn=#{errorMessage},mod_user_id='SYSTEM',mod_dttm=#{at} WHERE job_cd=#{key.jobCode} AND run_dt=#{key.runDate}
mapper.select: SELECT dev_id FROM tb_hr_dev ORDER BY dev_id
SELECT proj_id FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE ctrt_end_dt < #{today} AND proj_stat_cd='ING' ORDER BY proj_id
SELECT proj_id AS "id",proj_stat_cd AS "state",ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(max(hist_sn),0)::int FROM tb_pj_proj_chg WHERE proj_id=#{id}
SELECT asgn_id AS "id",proj_id AS "projectId",dev_id AS "developerId" FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND input_bgn_dt <= #{today} AND input_end_dt >= #{today} ORDER BY asgn_id

SELECT a.asgn_id AS "id",a.proj_id AS "projectId",a.dev_id AS "developerId",a.input_bgn_dt AS "startDate",a.input_end_dt AS "endDate", a.asgn_stat_cd AS "state",p.proj_stat_cd AS "projectState",a.ctrt_mm AS "mm",a.bill_uprc AS "price" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id WHERE a.asgn_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF a
SELECT asgn_id AS "id",proj_id AS "projectId",dev_id AS "developerId" FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE asgn_id=#{id}
SELECT max(close_ym) FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE'

SELECT hist_sn AS "serial",asgn_chg_type_cd AS "type",aply_dt AS "date",new_ctrt_mm AS "mm",new_uprc AS "price",crct_yn AS "corrected",crct_trgt_sn AS "target" FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist WHERE asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_dt,hist_sn
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_ym=#{month} AND close_stat_cd='CLOSE') OR #{month} < (SELECT min(std_val::bigint::text) FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM')
SELECT noti_id::text FROM tb_sy_noti WHERE noti_dttm < #{cutoff} ORDER BY noti_id

SELECT noti_id::text AS "id",rcvr_user_id AS "userId",noti_type_cd AS "type",noti_cn AS "content",link_scrn_id AS "screenId",link_key AS "linkKey", send_mthd_cd AS "method",read_yn AS "read",read_dttm AS "readAt",noti_dttm AS "notifiedAt",reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "registeredAt", mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modifiedAt" FROM tb_sy_noti WHERE noti_id=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) FOR UPDATE

SELECT pp.part_id AS "partId",COALESCE(p.hq_yn='Y',false) AS "headquarters",s.part_ldr_user_id AS "leaderId" FROM tb_pj_proj_part pp LEFT JOIN tb_bs_part p ON p.part_id=pp.part_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT part_ldr_user_id FROM tb_bs_part_std WHERE part_id=pp.part_id AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE pp.proj_id=#{id} AND pp.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY pp.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
